in_sanskrit.name: आश्रय
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who is a source of refuge, consolation and happiness. A goddess of fertility, prosperity and good fortune.

in_hindi.name: अश्रया
in_hindi.long_meaning: The one who is a source of refuge, consolation and happiness. A goddess of fertility, prosperity and good fortune.

in_tamil.name: அश்ரயா
in_tamil.long_meaning: The one who is knowledgeable, is alive, and is a protector. A goddess of wisdom, longevity and protection.

in_telugu.name: అశ్రెయ
in_telugu.long_meaning: The one who is a refuge, support, and a source of strength. A goddess of refuge, strength and prosperity.

in_marathi.name: Ashraya
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ashraya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ashraya is derived from the Sanskrit word 'ashraya', which means 'hope' or 'refuge'. In Hindu mythology, Ashraya is the goddess of hope, protection, and refuge. She is often depicted as a mother figure who provides shelter and care to those in need.
